description: Answers one offer from list_brand_offers for the person. "use" makes the sharp copy the company brand's icon, draws every icon again from it and records the brand's next version (the earlier version stays in its history). "keep-mine" keeps the brand as it is and sets that copy aside. "show-again" offers a copy the person set aside again (only for one listed as kept), so they can compare and answer again. Only owners and admins can. Answer only with what the person chose after seeing both pictures.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: answer_brand_offer
title: Use a sharp copy, or keep the brand's own picture
